provenance.note: A mellow bright grand: six stretched partials with a gentle tilt and a lid at 3.6 kHz, clear in the middle and never glassy, the hammer a short soft tick.

notes.copiedFrom: brightPiano, its numbers changed for a soft keys backdrop; held at nought (AWAITING) until a part admits it
notes.timbres: none declared yet: the loudness fit measures a timbre when a part admits the row
